title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
summary: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
summary: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
summary: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.
